school: 孔雀王朝皇帝/达摩治国王师/公示立法先驱/公共福利治理实践者/宗教对话开创者/帝国叙事的自我设计者
historical_significance: 阿育王（约前304-前232），印度孔雀王朝第三位皇帝，祖父旃陀罗笈多创建的帝国在他治下达到极盛——疆域覆盖几乎整个南亚次大陆。他在位的头八年是典型军事帝国路径：约前261年征服羯陵伽，史称十万余人被杀、十五万人被掳；他在羯陵伽诏书（Rock Edict XIII）中公开记载这场胜利并称之为'痛悔'（vipatisara），随后放弃武力扩张（bherighosa，'鼓声之政'），转向 dhammaghosa（'法音之政'）——这是人类历史上极罕见的由胜利者本人公开记录并系统忏悔自己战争罪行的案例。此后他以'达摩'（Dhamma/Dharma，伦理化的治国纲领，而非狭义佛教教义）为治国原则：在帝国全境立起数十根刻有法敕的石柱与摩崖——把王命直接刻在石头上向全民公示，是现存最早的君主立法公示文本；设立'达摩大官'（dhamma-mahamatta）巡视地方、救济苦难、监督各教派；在道路两旁植树掘井、设驿站与人畜医院，把公共福利写成国家职能；尊重一切教派（parama-samprati），为佛教第三次结集提供护持并向叙利亚、埃及、马其顿等地派出弘法使团。他生前帝国在他死后分裂，但他的石柱在两千年后仍被读到——阿拉伯商人伊本·阿比莱拉、1837年破译婆罗米文的普林塞普，使这位皇帝成为现代印度国徽（萨拉纳特狮子柱头）与国旗（法轮）的来源。
historical_significance_en: Ashoka (c. 304-232 BCE), third emperor of the Maurya dynasty, ruled an empire spanning nearly the whole subcontinent. His first eight years followed the classic military path: the conquest of Kalinga around 261 BCE, by his own edict's account killing over a hundred thousand and deporting as many more. In Rock Edict XIII he recorded that victory and named it remorse (vipatisara), then renounced armed expansion (bherighosa, rule by the drum) for dhammaghosa, rule by the sound of Dhamma—one of history's rarest cases of a victor publicly inscribing and systematically repenting his own atrocity. Thereafter he governed by 'Dhamma' (an ethical program of statecraft, not narrowly Buddhist doctrine): dozens of pillars and rock edicts across the empire—royal orders carved in stone for all to see, the earliest surviving published royal legislation; dhamma-mahamatta officers touring the provinces to relieve suffering and supervise all sects; wells, shade trees, rest houses and hospitals for men and beasts along the roads, making public welfare a function of state; parama-samprati, respect for all schools of religion; patronage of Buddhism's Third Council and missions to Syria, Egypt and Macedonia. His empire fragmented after his death, but the pillars were read again two millennia later—from Ibn Abi Layla to Prinsep's 1837 decipherment of Brahmi—making this emperor the source of modern India's national emblem (the Sarnath lion capital) and flag (the Dharma wheel).
description_zh: 阿育王的思维底色是'在权力的最高点公开翻转自身'：羯陵伽之战的胜利仪式，被他改造成公开忏悔仪式——他在诏书里命令后代子民读到他的悔恨，这是把君主制最不透明的机构（帝王之心）变成可公开审读的文本。由此产生四种独特能力：一是'公示立法'（把王命刻在石头与摩崖上，路人都可读到，立誓条文接受全民监督——权力第一次以书面契约姿态面对被治者）；二是'胜利的重定义'（把'征服'从领土吞并改写为'德服'——领土扩张停了，帝国反而获得了道德扩张的新轴线）；三是'多教派共生管理'（尊重一切宗派、禁止内部诽谤，把宗教冲突从零和博弈改造成伦理公约数工程）；四是'国家福利的工程化'（水井、行道树、驿站、人畜医疗写进施政清单，把仁慈从动机变成可检查的交付物）。他还做了两件极超前的事：设立巡视帝国、直报国王的达摩大官，构成早期监察体系；设计自己的历史形象——他对后世说话，而非只对当代臣民说话，两千年后的印度把他刻上国徽。他证明：权力的最高级形态不是胜利的记录，而是对胜利的重新审问。
description_en: Ashoka's thinking was 'the public reversal of self at the summit of power': he turned the victory ritual of Kalinga into a public ritual of remorse, ordering future subjects to read his regret in the edicts—converting the most opaque organ of monarchy, the king's heart, into a text for public audit. From this flow four distinct capacities: first, published legislation (royal orders carved on pillars and rock faces, legible to any passerby, pledging provisions to universal scrutiny—power facing the governed for the first time in the posture of a written covenant); second, the redefinition of victory (conquest rewritten from territorial annexation to conquest by Dhamma—territorial expansion stopped, yet the empire gained a new axis of moral expansion); third, symbiotic management of many sects (respect for all schools and bans on internal slander, converting religious conflict from zero-sum contest into a project of ethical common denominators); fourth, the engineering of state welfare (wells, shade trees, rest houses, medical care for men and beasts written into the administrative list, turning benevolence from motive into a checkable deliverable). Two further acts were strikingly ahead of their time: dhamma-mahamatta officers touring the empire and reporting directly to the king—an early inspectorate; and the deliberate design of his own historical image—he spoke to posterity, not only to contemporaries, and two millennia later India carved him into its emblem. He proved that the highest form of power is not the record of victory but the public re-interrogation of victory.
roles_zh: 孔雀王朝皇帝（约前268-前232年在位，帝国极盛）
羯陵伽征服者与公开忏悔者（Rock Edict XIII）
石柱与摩崖法敕的发起人（现存最早的君主公示立法）
达摩治国纲领的设计者（dhamma-vijaya，法胜）
达摩大官（dhamma-mahamatta）监察体系的创建者
佛教第三次结集的护持者与国际弘法使团的派出者
roles_en: Emperor of the Maurya dynasty (r. c. 268-232 BCE, imperial zenith)
Conqueror of Kalinga and public penitent (Rock Edict XIII)
Originator of the pillar and rock edicts (earliest surviving published royal legislation)
Designer of the Dhamma program of governance (dhamma-vijaya, conquest by Dhamma)
Patron of Buddhism's Third Council and sender of international missions

七根柱敕（Pillar Edicts I-VII，含第一至第七柱法敕）
十四摩崖法敕（Major Rock Edicts I-XIV）
小摩崖法敕（Minor Rock Edicts，含王名'Brahmagiri 版'首次署名 Devanampiya Asoka）

分敕（Separate Rock Edicts，针对税吏与地方官的专门行政指令）
